analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo (India) Limited recorded a revenue of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operations and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 809.85 lakhs for FY 2024-25. The company completed the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business into Vikram Aroma Limited, which commenced trading in March 2025. The Board of Directors recommended a 10% dividend on equity shares amounting to Rs.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to investing in R&D, adopting emerging technologies, and enhancing its product portfolio moving forward.
guidance.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

guidance.claim: The company aims to build a sustainable business model focusing on profitable revenue growth and launching high-margin, research-based products.
guidance.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to ongoing investment in R&D and expanding its product portfolio.
guidance.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

guidance.claim: In fiscal 2024, Vikram Thermo plans to continue its transformation by entering new markets with favorable competition and developing complex new products.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

guidance.claim: The company plans to leverage its R&D capabilities and customer-centric products to achieve growth.
guidance.quote: We will leverage our R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and our customer-centric products to attain newer heights.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's PAN-India presence and expanding global footprint contributed to its growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our extensive PAN-India presence, along with a steadily expanding global footprint, has significantly contributed to the Company's growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The company recorded a revenue of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operations in FY 2024-25.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company recorded a revenue of Rs.12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operation and Rs.451.98 lakhs from discontinuing operation and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of Rs.809.85 lakhs.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's pan-India presence and expanding global footprint have yielded strong benefits.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred no capital expenditure on Research and Development during the financial year.
The Board approved a demerger scheme to transfer the Aromatic Chemical Business into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

margins_costs.claim: The reduction in PAT was primarily caused by the demerger of a business unit.
margins_costs.quote: While the PAT reflects a decrease primarily due to the demerger of a business unit, the overall performance of the continuing operations has shown notable improvement.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue expenditure incurred on Research and Development for the year stood at Rs. 27,81,809.43.
The company recorded its highest-ever performance with revenue of Rs. 12,639.54 lacs and profit after tax of Rs. 2,537.87 lacs in FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: The revenue of Rs. 12639.54 lacs and profit after tax of Rs. 2537.87 lacs is best ever in the history of the company.

margins_costs.claim: Vikram Thermo achieved its highest total income and net profit in company history in FY 2023.
margins_costs.quote: You will be happy to note that during FY 2023, your company achieved the highest total income and profits in its history.

margins_costs.claim: Operating income grew 20.95% to Rs. 112.89 crores while profit after tax expanded 94.59% to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.
margins_costs.quote: Our operating income grew to Rs. 112.89 crores, a growth of 20.95% as compared to the previous FY 2022, Our profits after tax increased by 94.59% from Rs. 8.69 crores, in FY 2022 to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 10% dividend on equity shares of Rs. 10 each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed dividend payout will involve a total cash outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any amount from profit to reserves for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: An amount of Rs. 52,00,000 was spent towards Corporate Social Responsibility obligations in FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is pleased to inform the members that an amount of Rs. 52,00,000 towards its CSR obligation for 2024-25 has been spent which is over and above the requirement as specified by the Government and it is committed to further spend appropriate amount towards its obligation of the current financial year during 2024-25 as well.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 7.5% (Rs. 0.75 per share) on equity shares for FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payout will involve a total cash outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/- (Previous Year Rs. 1,56,78,925/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to general reserves during FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed dividend payout represents a total cash outflow of Rs. 1,56,78,925.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs.1,56,78,925/- (Previous Year Rs.94,07,355/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared and allotted bonus shares in a ratio of 4 equity shares for every 1 equity share held.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the company has declared issue of bonus shares to the shareholders in the ratio of 4 Equity shares for every 1 equity shares held.

risks_headwinds.claim: The demerger of the Aromatic Chemicals business aims to isolate risks between the respective businesses.
risks_headwinds.quote: The demerger would also help each company to isolate the risks between their respective businesses, raise capital based on their individual requirements and unlock value in future.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company implemented a Risk Management Policy to address risks that may threaten its existence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted global uncertainties and challenges stemming from the aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic during the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through high-margin, research-driven products.
management_commitments.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to consistently investing in research and development and enhancing its product range.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

management_commitments.claim: In fiscal 2024, the company will expand into new markets with favorable competitive dynamics and focus on complex new products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
